name: Microsoft DSC v3
description: Installs Microsoft Desired State Configuration v3 (https://github.com/PowerShell/DSC) whole into /opt/dsc (dsc discovers its bundled resources from its own directory on PATH) and verifies the release tarball against a sha256 digest pinned in the Feature, read from the release page, or set via the sha256 option (the GitHub API is never called). The PowerShell adapter resources need pwsh (ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/powershell).

installTaskfile.description: Also install this Feature's Taskfile into /usr/local/share/go-task/includes.d so its tasks appear under the <id>: namespace of a root Taskfile that includes /usr/local/share/go-task/features.yml (see the go-task Feature).

version.description: DSC release to install (e.g. '3.3.0', with or without a leading 'v'), or 'latest'.

sha256.description: Expected sha256 of the release tarball for this platform. When empty, the digest comes from the Feature's pinned list (digests.txt) or, for other versions, from the release page on github.com.
